<a id="sfx_cmd_offsets"></a>
### [`sfx_cmd_offsets`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L13) `$EC03-$EC10`

*data*

Branch offsets into the effect jump tables, indexed by the stream command byte. Entries 0-7 are the commands; entries 8-13 would branch past the jump table and no stream uses them.

- **Referred to by:** [`sfx_voice1_update`](sfx_voice1.md#sfx_voice1_update) [`$EB31`](../../../src/sfx_voice1.asm#L44), [`sfx_voice2_update`](sfx_voice2.md#sfx_voice2_update) [`$EFA1`](../../../src/sfx_voice2.asm#L44), [`sfx_voice3_update`](sfx_voice3.md#sfx_voice3_update) [`$F0A1`](../../../src/sfx_voice3.asm#L44)

<a id="sfx_adsr_table"></a>
### [`sfx_adsr_table`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L18) `$EC11-$EC1A`

*data*

Effect envelopes, indexed by an even ADSR index: pairs of AD, SR. Index 0 $11/$97, 2 $00/$F0, 4 $89/$00, 6 $09/$40, 8 $08/$00. Index 10 and 12 read into sfx_pulse_table ($0C/$07 and $02/$08).

<a id="sfx_footstep_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_footstep_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L35) `$EC31-$EC36`

*data*

Effect streams. Each command: command byte 0-7, then its operands. Command 0 = end; 1 = duration, note; 2 = duration, note, control; 3 = duration, note, ADSR index, control; 4 = duration, note, ADSR index, pulse index, control; 5 and 6 = duration, note, pulse index, control; 7 = control. Duration in frames (0 = 256), note = index in note_freq_lo/hi. Effect 0 ($80), footstep: 1 frame of noise. Requested on each step of a walk or climb animation of any actor (actor_play_step_sound).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_yamo_arrives_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_yamo_arrives_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L39) `$EC37-$EC46`

*data*

Effect 1 ($81): low pulse A#1, C2, B1, A#1 (32 frames). Requested by yamo_start_pose when Yamo's state goes from $10 to $12, and with the statue mouth animation of rooms 0 and 2 (room00_frame, room02_frame).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_enemy_enters_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_enemy_enters_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L44) `$EC47-$EC79`

*data*

Effect 2 ($82): 12 frames of high pulse notes. Requested when Yamo (spawn_yamo) or the Ninja (spawn_ninja) enters the room, through play_enemy_spawn_sound.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_unused_3_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_unused_3_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L53) `$EC7A-$EC8F`

*data*

Effect 3 ($83): noise C7, C8, B7, C8, C5, C2. No code requests it.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_kick_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_kick_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L59) `$EC90-$ECBD`

*data*

Effect 4 ($84): rising noise sweep (21 frames). Requested in the kick states $0C and $0D at step $0C (actor_continue_action: act_check_kick_left, act_check_kick_right); Bruce and Yamo use it.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_swing_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_swing_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L68) `$ECBE-$ECD7`

*data*

Effect 5 ($85): short rising noise (6 frames). Requested when the Ninja swings the bokken (state $16, act_strike_phase) and in state $11 at step 8 (act_check_punch).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_impact_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_impact_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L75) `$ECD8-$ECEB`

*data*

Effect 6 ($86): falling noise C8 to C1 (5 frames), played by play_hit_sound. Requested when a punch, kick or fall attack hits an actor (check_fight_collisions) and when room 18 launches a fireball (launch_fireball0/1).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_bokken_hit_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_bokken_hit_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L81) `$ECEC-$ED0D`

*data*

Effect 7 ($87): rising triangle arpeggio C4-G7 (8 frames). Requested when the Ninja's bokken (attacker state $16) hits an actor (check_fight_strike).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_unused_8_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_unused_8_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L88) `$ED0E-$ED58`

*data*

Effect 8 ($88): falling gated pulse arpeggio F#7 to C#5, G5 (20 frames). No code requests it.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_runner_step_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_runner_step_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L101) `$ED59-$ED5F`

*data*

Effect 9 ($89): one pulse note C6 (ADSR index 12). Requested by play_runner_sound on each step of a runner hazard (draw_runner_step, draw_runner_step_alt); rooms 7, 9, 13 and 17.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_passage_opens_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_passage_opens_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L107) `$ED60-$ED8D`

*data*

Effect 10 ($8A): 16 silent frames, a low wobble, then B6 for 47 frames. Played by play_open_sound when the scenery changes: passages open (open_passage, open_passage_dark), trapdoors open (room01_frame, room03_frame), room 2 opens its floor, room 4 removes its barriers, rooms 9 and 15 open their exits; frame_update also plays it once (room time).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_wizard_defeated_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_wizard_defeated_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L116) `$ED8E-$EDC7`

*data*

Effect 11 ($8B): A7 alternating noise and pulse+triangle, then E4, A3. Requested on each step of the wizard defeat sequence of room 18 (room18_wizard_defeated_sound), which also flashes random colours and the charset.

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_hazard_death_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_hazard_death_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L128) `$EDC8-$EE06`

*data*

Effect 12 ($8C): pulse C#4/C4 with pulse width steps, then falling. Requested when an actor touches a deadly tile (touch_deadly_tile, not in room 18); then Bruce goes to state $19 (set_actor_hazard_death) or the enemy is removed (remove_actor).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_trap_burst_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_trap_burst_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L139) `$EE07-$EE18`

*data*

Effect 13 ($8D): noise D#2 with jumps, then 96 frames of low noise. Played by play_burst_sound when the timer of a burst trap slot (touch_trap_tile starts it, tile $60) reaches 8 and the trap bursts (update_burst_traps).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)

<a id="sfx_lantern_stream"></a>
### [`sfx_lantern_stream`](../../../src/sfx_data.asm#L146) `$EE19-$EE82`

*data*

Effect 14 ($8E): sawtooth arpeggios B minor, A minor, B minor (26 frames). Requested when Bruce collects a lantern (collect_lantern, +125 points) and when he takes the room 16 extra-fall pickup (collect_room16_bonus_check_y).

- **Entry of:** [`sfx_stream_table`](../tables.md#sfx_stream_table)
